en: Nyeh...

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel as though I'm
getting used to this...
Breathing makes me too tired...

Breathing!? You need to breathe
or you'll die, you know!

It's fine...I'll just suck in 
oxygen with my magic...

<CLT=cltMIND>That's impossible! I have to think
of something that will perk her up, quick!

H-Hey, Himiko! Can you continue
the story you were telling before?

The story from before?
What was it again...?

When you became an apprentice, and
you went up on stage with your master...

Nyeh?
What's the point of telling you?
Point? No, that's not...

Well I guess you can't help it. 
A mystical mage is right in front of you.

Oh well. That's just how it is.
I'll show you how special mages are...

And I'll teach you just how many 
hardships I had to go through...

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko closed her eyes and inhaled a deep
breath. Then, she slowly began speaking.

As I traveled the world with my 
master, I realized something odd...

When I was onstage, the audience was 
cheering for me, not my master...

I thought...there's no way they'd 
be cheering for me over my master.
No way?

Of course not. My master is a great 
mage that exceeds even me.

But I knew what was 
really happening.
What do you mean?

We were sent letters and gifts from 
fans all the time, but...
They were all addressed to me.

They...lied about how great I was 
and called my master old fashioned.
Huh...

They were terrible...to make a trap 
like that. I didn't want their praise.
A trap?

That's right. It was all a trap 
to make me leave my master.

Someone trying to take my master's title 
of archmage did something so sneaky...

<CLT=cltMIND>No, I don't think it's something
nefarious like that... Nothing that complicated.

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps it was around that time that
the apprentice succeeded her master...

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Magician<CLT=cltMIND>,
after all.
But...it worked.
It worked?
My master...got caught in the trap.

The curse in the letters affected him 
and slowly drained him of his powers...

People started to notice me more...
I was invited to magic shows...

Most of them wanted to make 
me the headline, not my master.

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko stared at her feet, shoulders shaking.
I couldn't tell if she was angry or sad...

Everyone's stupid!
My master's the best mage!

That's why I—his pupil—became such
a great mage.

Why don't they get that!? There's no 
way I'm...better than my master.
Himiko...

<CLT=cltMIND>My voice sounded so unlike me,
unusually sympathetic and consoling.

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko must have known...
She had outgrown her master.
And then...my master...
Yes...?
The story ends here.
Huh?

I'm tired of talking.
I'm closed for today...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Himiko's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>I watched Himiko walk away,
and I returned to my room.
